tools.name: get_live_status
tools.description: Report whether Taren Raider is live on Twitch right now, including the current game, stream title, viewer count, and start time when live. Use this for any question about whether the stream is currently live.

tools.name: get_schedule
tools.description: Return the weekly Taren Raider stream plan with each day’s game and the exact ISO-8601 instant of the next stream. Use this to answer when Taren streams next or what is planned for a given day. Optionally pass an IANA timezone to render every time in the caller’s zone.

tools.name: get_latest_vods
tools.description: List the most recent Taren Raider videos with title, publish date, and watch URL. Use this when asked about recent content, VODs, or what to watch. Optionally limit the number of results between 1 and 20 (default 5).

tools.name: search_merch
tools.description: Search the official Taren Raider merch store by product name and return matching products with their lowest price and buy link. Use this for any question about available shirts, stickers, or other merchandise.

tools.name: get_site_info
tools.description: Return a factual profile of Taren Raider: what the channel is, platforms and handles, Discord invite, contact email, and the canonical website. Use this for identity questions or "where can I find" questions about the streamer.

findings.title: Lethal trifecta: untrusted input + private data + external sink
findings.detail: Server "mcp" exposes tools that together enable an exfiltration flow. Untrusted content: get_latest_vods, get_site_info · Private data: get_site_info · Public sink: get_latest_vods, get_site_info.

evidence.snippet: Untrusted content: get_latest_vods, get_site_info · Private data: get_site_info · Public sink: get_latest_vods, get_site_info

findings.remediation: Do not co-install these capabilities under one trust boundary; an injected comment/email can steer the model to exfiltrate via the sink tool.
